day_shape: Iranian drone-and-missile strike on Kuwait International Airport kills one and prompts expulsion of two Iranian diplomats, IDF declares 'no ceasefire' in Lebanon with 20+ Hezbollah sites destroyed, CENTCOM reports 125 vessels redirected under US blockade, two UNSC meetings on Iran and Lebanon.

threads.label: Kuwait airport strike and Gulf fallout
threads.summary: Kuwait confirmed one civilian killed and several wounded by an Iranian drone-and-missile attack on the international airport, expelling two Iranian diplomats and summoning Tehran's chargé d'affaires. Bahrain's military claimed it downed three Iranian missiles and drones in a joint operation with US CENTCOM, while IRGC blamed the terminal damage on a faulty American Patriot interceptor.

threads.label: Lebanon front: IDF strikes, Hezbollah fire
threads.summary: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir told Haifa Naval Base personnel 'there is no ceasefire for our forces' in Lebanon, as Division 91 destroyed a Hezbollah weapons depot and 20+ infrastructure sites overnight using six tonnes of explosives. Hezbollah fired two rockets at Misgav Am and a drone at Kiryat Shmona, both intercepted, while Israeli strikes hit vehicles in Khalde and Deir ez-Zahrani and a Golani Brigade handover was held at Beaufort Castle.

threads.label: US-Iran talks and Lebanon stumbling block
threads.summary: Iran International reported Lebanon emerging as a key obstacle to Tehran-Washington negotiations, while Netanyahu told reporters US-Iran military action could resume and a Trump-Netanyahu phone call addressed IDF plans to strike Beirut. Parliament foreign-policy chair Azizi told Hezbollah's Iran representative that 'stopping the war on all fronts' is at the forefront of any agreement text with America.

threads.label: US naval blockade and Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Rafael Peralta is patrolling the Arabian Sea enforcing the US blockade of Iran, with 125 commercial vessels redirected and six disabled as of 3 June. Iran's Foreign Ministry held Bahrain and Kuwait responsible for US strikes on a regime-linked tanker in the Strait of Hormuz and on a Qeshm Island telecommunications tower; FM Araghchi said armed forces are conducting defensive attacks within self-defence.

threads.label: Iranian retaliation rhetoric and Imam Khomeini commemoration
threads.summary: Speaker Qalibaf, IRGC commander Rezaei, the Army and parliamentary commission members issued statements tying the 14 Khordad anniversary of Imam Khomeini's death to vows that 'cost-free threats' against Iran have ended and any aggression will draw missile-and-drone responses. Defa Press also released 'Announcement No. 1' on funeral planning for the 'Martyred Imam Ayatollah Khamenei', denying media speculation about ceremony details.

threads.label: Humanitarian and regional fallout
threads.summary: UN OCHA's UNHCR weekly update reported escalating hostilities in Iran and Lebanon driving refugee returns to Afghanistan and Syria across a region hosting over 24 million displaced people, with a separate Iran factsheet citing 1.65 million forcibly displaced in country. Defa Press cited Gaza health authorities reporting 72,945 cumulative dead and 939 killed since the 11 October ceasefire; Iran International said Iranians report wages consumed by rent, food and medical costs.

threads.label: Iran internal security and Iraqi militia signals
threads.summary: Defa Press and Ministry of Intelligence channels announced the arrest of Fatahallah Awari over the killing of Brigadier Bakshayan, the seizure of a 'sabotage equipment' shipment in the northwest, and the Jerusalem Post cited a UK government bulletin reporting increased Iranian military presence and checkpoints in the Kurdish region. The Jerusalem Post also reported Iran-backed Iraqi militias Saraya al-Salam and the Imam Ali Brigades signalling plans to place weapons under state control under US pressure.

events.summary_en: Urgent warning to Lebanese residents in the following towns and villages: Arzi (Sidon), Mzaraa Koura al-Rez, al-Zararia. In light of Hezbollah terrorist organisation's breach of the ceasefire agreement and its targeting of the Israeli home front, the IDF is compelled to act against it forcefully, particularly in your areas. The IDF does not intend to harm you. For your safety you must evacuate your homes immediately and relocate north of the Litani River. Anyone in the vicinity of Hezbollah elements and their facilities and combat means exposes his life to danger!

events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them.
